title: Putting up lights
description: Drudge up the lights, test them, and ultimately deploy them.

advanceSteps.title: Determine Christmas light type according to the Annual Rotation Treaty (A.R.T.)
advanceSteps.description: White in even years, color in odd years.

advanceSteps.title: Discuss light location expansions with household decision makers
Audit current light inventory compared to intended deployment zones
advanceSteps.description: Include smart switches and extension cables, and make sure there are lights for the Christmas tree.
